evidence.detail: No favorite/bookmark deck infrastructure exists in the codebase
bakert: 'Theory: if you really like a deck you will play it. Then it'll be on your player page for all time. So this feature may not be that useful.' — indicates product skepticism
silasary: 'This comes back to the idea of a "Register in League with this deck" button' — competing design direction raised
Issue labeled both + feature and + question, confirming open design uncertainty

triage.notes: Owner judgment needed on whether this is better served by a favorites list, a league-registration-from-deck button, or neither. The feature would also require a new DB table, OAuth-gated writes, and UI changes.
